scopes.name: android_camera
scopes.purpose: Scan local host QR pairing payload.

scopes.name: android_location
scopes.purpose: Collect cached fused location fixes after local confirmation.

scopes.name: same_lan_http
scopes.purpose: Expose location/status endpoints to paired hosts or Open LAN consumers on the local network.

scopes.name: same_lan_mdns
scopes.purpose: Advertise active miniloc sharing with Android NSD/mDNS on the local network.

scopes.name: adb_deploy
scopes.purpose: Install and launch debug APK during development.

scopes.name: release_signing
scopes.purpose: Read release keystore and passwords from environment for signed packaging.

delete: clear pairing and cached fixes through phone UI or authenticated /forget_pairing

phone_user: launch app to start Open LAN sharing
network_admin: allow same-LAN host-to-phone connectivity when Wi-Fi client isolation is present
